title: Frequently Asked Questions
summary: Common questions and answers about visiting Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha.

questions.a: Morning: 6:00 AM - 12:30 PM, Evening: 5:00 PM - 8:30 PM. Timings may extend during festivals and special occasions. Please contact the temple office for current timings.
Traditional Indian attire is recommended. Saree or salwar kameez for women, kurta-pajama or dhoti for men. Please ensure shoulders and knees are covered.
Photography is not allowed inside the sanctum or main shrine area. External photography of the temple architecture is permitted. Flash photography is prohibited throughout.
Yes, parking facilities are available. Please contact the temple office for current parking information and any specific guidance during festivals.
Annadanam is the free meal program offered to devotees. Please contact the temple or check on arrival for current timings and availability.
Sevas can be booked online through our website or at the temple counter. Please visit the sevas section for more information.
Yes, wheelchair access with ramps is available at the main entrance. Special assistance can be requested from temple staff.

questions.q: What is the best time to visit?
questions.a: Weekdays are generally less crowded. Early morning hours (6-8 AM) offer a peaceful darshan experience. During weekends and festivals, expect larger crowds.
Please contact the temple office regarding accommodation availability, booking procedures, and current rates.

questions.q: How can I make a donation?
questions.a: Donations can be made online through our website, via UPI, bank transfer, or at the temple counter. Please visit the donation section for details.
